summary.text: Eldest son of Amyclas who held the Laconian throne after his father's death in Pausanias' king-list, before the kingdom passed to his brother Cynortas.
Apollodorus omits this reign and makes Cynortas succeed Amyclas directly; the name also appears as Argalus in some modern transliterations.

story.text: Amyclas, son of Lacedaemon, built a town in Laconia as a memorial. On his death the empire came to Aigalus, the eldest of his sons, and when Aigalus died it passed to Cynortas, who had a son Oebalus.
